## Alertmanager -> AI triage -> chat
POST `/webhook/ftw-alertmanager-triage` with header auth (credential **Triage webhook auth**).
Edit the **Settings** node: LLM endpoint + model, and the chat webhook URL.
Firing groups get an AI summary; resolved groups get a short message and never reach the LLM.
Free edition of the FTW n8n incident triage pack.
